title: Žaġręn V0.9 R03 名词与代词分级审订矩阵
authority: review-only; lexicon headwords and existing V0.6 scoped examples are distinguished from non-normative paradigms
principle: Historical literary paradigms, modern headwords, and pilot model inflections are separate evidence layers. No novel case ending is certified by matching a generated candidate to another generated candidate.

reviewQuestions.name: A与O类名词对照
reviewQuestions.focus: 检查数格后缀及阴阳性、一致关系，不把词尾复制视为现代证据。

reviewQuestions.name: 有生性与宾格
reviewQuestions.focus: 单数有生与复数宾格须分别核验，西部za仅限既有受控用例。

reviewQuestions.name: 西部朋友词干
reviewQuestions.focus: 词典主格dru不保证所有斜格保留早期druġ；11格仍为校准模板候选。

reviewQuestions.name: 人称代词
reviewQuestions.focus: 7人称×6格×3方言中只有21个主格是无条件现行词典原形；A01和A02的6个与格用法仅在受控句中成立。

reviewQuestions.name: 代词介词及性数格
reviewQuestions.focus: 不能因现代某个介词短语存在就推出全部属格、处所格和工具格格尾。
